title: Verified Record Cards Batch 001 — First Proof Conversion
mission: Create the first record-proof layer from the upgrade targets. These cards verify official record locations and define the exact content classification still needed for full evidence upgrades.
boundary: These VRCs are preliminary verified record cards. They verify the official record location, record type and tracker relevance. They do not verify detailed record contents until the selected filing, policy page, public award result or disclosure file is opened and classified.
